sloka: न वासवेनापि सहस्रचक्षुषा ।युधास्मि शक्यो वरुणेन वा पुनः ।मया त्वियम् बाहुबलेन निर्जिता ।पुरा पुरी वैश्रवणेन पालिता ॥६-१३-२१॥
transliteration: na vāsavenāpi sahasracakṣuṣā ।yudhāsmi śakyo varuṇena vā punaḥ ।mayā tviyam bāhubalena nirjitā ।purā purī vaiśravaṇena pālitā ॥6-13-21॥

translations.english: "Even for the thousand eyed Indra or Lord Varuna it is not possible to withstand me in combat. In the past I have won this city ruled by Kubera with huge strength." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रयोदशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the thirteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: पू्वेकाल भें कुबेर द्वारा पालित यह लङ्कापुरी मैंने अपने बाहुवल से जीती है
